title: ui: after the holder-package fix, the permission-set pages still read a few things by name: the confirm label, the clone hosts, a package-less grant, the single-pick ledger and the flat 409 body on Add
body:
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUAXJEaRNwDiLuAvEZ

Follow-up of #32537 (PR #32769). Part of #31527 (ADR-0150). These become visible once #31698 PR-2 lets a second package hold a permission-set name.

Filing category: ② follow-up of a reviewed PR. reach: the epic red-line read of PR #32769 at head `a0724ef2` (comment 6829073582) listed these as nits for a follow-up card, with no extra round on the PR (epic #31527 rule). Line numbers below are at that head; re-read them on `main` once PR #32769 lands. If PR #32769's rework already closes an item, strike it here.

## 维护者速读

PR #32769 让权限集页面在写入时带上持有包，并在 409 时让管理员从候选包中选择。复读时还剩几处小地方仍按名字取值：确认框和提示里的标签取同名的第一行；两个克隆入口没有传源包；不带包的授权在两个包都持有时哪边都不列；单候选选择后台账只更新按名状态；#32740 之后 Add 被拒时读不到扁平的 candidates。都不放宽服务端判定，但在 #31698 PR-2 之后会让界面显示或选择不准确。

## What happens (at `a0724ef2`)

1. `labelOf` takes the first row of a name (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx` ~477-480). The confirm, the toast and the pick title can show the other holder's label, and the confirm never names the package.
2. Neither clone host passes `sourcePackage` (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx:2179`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:10554`). With holders [environment, A], the bare name clones the environment's set with no pick.
3. A grant that names no package, under a name two packages hold, is listed under neither holder. The server reads such a row as granting nothing (ADR-0150 D8 R1); the page should still show it somewhere the admin can see and fix it, without listing it as a grant of either holder.
4. The comment at `ResourceListPage.tsx` ~1030-1032 ("ONE holder per deployment") is stale.
5. After a single-candidate pick, `ledgerAfterSwitch` updates only the by-name state, not the `(package, name)` entry.
6. After #32740, `/data` sends a flat error body, so through the client `err.details` is `{ candidates }`. `holderCandidatesOf` reads only the wrapped `error.code` / `error.details` (`permission-set-holder.ts` ~148-153), and Add reads only the message (`AssignedUsersSection.tsx:502`). A refused Add shows the server's sentence with no pick. `addUsers` should also read `err.details.candidates`.

## Expected

- Labels, clone sources and ledger state are keyed by `(package, name)` wherever the page already holds the holder; the confirm names the package when there are two holders.
- A package-less grant under two holders is shown as unresolved (generic blocks only), never assigned to a holder by order.
- A refused Add opens the same holder pick as the other doors, with either error body shape.
- One holder per name: requests and screens unchanged (CONTROL).

Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`@object-ui/app-shell`). Triage decides the grade; it sits on the #31527 release line after PR #32769.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue labelOf holder` → 0 hits, `is:issue ledgerAfterSwitch` → 0 hits, `is:issue sourcePackage clone permission` → 1 hit (#32164, closed: the server doors). The nearest are #32537 (the parent), #32770 (the `permission-ref` picker) and #32740 (the flat `/data` body).

Related: #32537, PR #32769, #32770, #32740, #31698, #31527.
